Django News Application
  • API reference

news.forms

Validated HTML forms for the news application.

The forms restrict choices according to the signed-in user role and provide cleaned data to the corresponding views.

Classes

ArticleForm

Create or edit an article and enforce journalist publisher affiliations.

NewsletterForm

Create or edit a newsletter from approved articles.

RegistrationForm

Sign-up form that collects username, email, role, and password.

SubscriptionForm

Let a reader choose the publishers and journalists they follow.

Details

news.forms.PUBLIC_REGISTRATION_ROLES = [(User.Roles.READER, 'Reader'), (User.Roles.JOURNALIST, 'Journalist')]

Roles a visitor may choose when registering. Editor accounts are created by an administrator.

class news.forms.RegistrationForm(*args, **kwargs)[source]

Bases: UserCreationForm

Sign-up form that collects username, email, role, and password.

Extends Django’s UserCreationForm with a required email address and a choice of account role. Only the reader and journalist roles can be chosen; editors are created by an administrator.

class news.forms.ArticleForm(*args, user=None, **kwargs)[source]

Bases: ModelForm

Create or edit an article and enforce journalist publisher affiliations.

Journalists can only choose publishers they are affiliated with. Leaving the publisher empty submits the article as an independent article.

Parameters:

  • *args – Positional arguments passed to ModelForm.

  • user (news.models.User, optional) – The signed-in user. Used to limit the publisher choices and to set the article owner.

  • **kwargs – Keyword arguments passed to ModelForm.

clean()[source]

Check publisher affiliation and record who owns the article.

For journalists, the article’s author is set on the form instance before model validation runs: the journalist for an independent article, or None for a publisher article.

Returns:

The cleaned form data.

Return type:

dict

Raises:

django.forms.ValidationError – If a journalist selects a publisher they are not affiliated with.

Create or edit a newsletter from approved articles.

Parameters:

  • *args – Positional arguments passed to ModelForm.

  • user (news.models.User, optional) – The signed-in user, recorded as the author of a new newsletter.

  • **kwargs – Keyword arguments passed to ModelForm.

save(commit=True)[source]

Save the newsletter, setting the author on first save.

Parameters:

commit (bool) – If True (the default), write the newsletter and its article selections to the database.

Returns:

The saved (or unsaved) newsletter.

Return type:

news.models.Newsletter
